title: Kapfenberg Storm Back From 0-2 to Dethrone Oberwart for an Eighth Crown
description: Down 0-2 and staring at the end of their season, the Kapfenberg Bulls did not flinch. The Styrians reeled off three straight wins to stun the two-time defending champion Oberwart Gunners, capping the comeback with a 94-80 Game 5 victory at home to claim the win2day Basketball Superliga title the eighth championship in the club's history. It is a comeback with an echo: the only other time Kapfenberg overturned a 0-2 deficit to win a best-of-five final was in 2003, against Gmunden. As winners of the regular season and the placement round, the Bulls had entered the series as the top seed, only to drop two tight games. From there they flipped the script entirely.
imageCaption: Kapfenberg overturn series from 0-2 to 3-2 and clinch title (Photo: basketballaustria.at)

title: Oberwart sweep BBC Nord to clinch BSL title
description: Oberwart - BBC Nord 75-67 It was a great evening for American forward Robert Allen (206-2000, college: N.Texas, agency: Elevate Sports Alliance) who led his team to a victory scoring 19 points and 8 rebounds. His fellow American import forward Ziggy Reid (198-2000, college: YSU, agency: Inception Sports) helped adding 17 points and 9 rebounds. The best for the losing side was British power forward Peter Turay (203-1999, college: CMU) with 16 points and 9 rebounds and American point guard Rayshawn Mart (190-1998, college: Xavier, LA) scored 17 points and 6 rebounds. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: Oberwart sweep BBC Nord to clinch BSL title (Photo: BSL)

title: Oberwart Gunners are BSL 23/24 champions
description: UBSC Graz - Oberwart 80-81 Oberwart Gunners are the new Bundesliga champions. They overcame UBSC Graz in thriller tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series. UBSC Graz was tied after three quarters but could not keep up in the last quarter eventually losing the game. Oberwart looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a great evening for Canadian point guard Munis Tutu (183-1996, college: Carleton, agency: Inception Sports) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 24 points and 11 assists. Dutch center Shaquille Rombley (203-1996, college: LMU) helped adding 15 points and 13 rebounds. Gunners Oberwart's coach Horst Leitner used a ten-player rotation in such tough game. imageCaption: Oberwart Gunners are BSL 23/24 champions (Photo: news.basketballaustria.at)

title: BSL Round 4 of Finals. Swans Gmunden crowned champions
description: Vienna - Gmunden 79-83 Gmunden claimed Superliga title. They overcame Vienna on the road to lift the sixth League title. BC Vienna was trailing by 5 points at halftime but managed to get 3-point lead after three quarters before a 28-21 charge of Gmunden Swans, which allowed them to win the game. They made 19-of-25 free shots (76.0 percent) during the game. Worth to mention a great performance of American power forward Urald King (198-1990, college: SE Oklahoma) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 21 points and 11 rebounds. The former international guard Daniel Friedrich (181-1992) contributed with 25 points and 7 assists for the winners. Canadian guard Jahenns-Ley Manigat (186-1991, college: Creighton) replied with 21 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists and Serbian forward Stefan Savic (200-1995) added 18 points and 9 rebounds in the effort for BC Vienna. title: BC Vienna celebrate BSL title
description: Gmunden - Vienna 60-86 Vienna clinched BSL title. They cruised past Gmunden on the road in Game 4 to conquer the trophy. The game without a history. BC Vienna led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They dominated on the defensive end, holding Gmunden Swans to just 6 points in fourth quarter. Worth to mention a great performance of international guard Bogic Vujosevic (192-1992) who helped to win the game recording 25 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists. American center Michael Hughes (203-1998, college: Duquesne) contributed with 16 points and 5 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field) for the winners. Five BC Vienna players scored in double figures. The former international forward Toni Blazan (197-1992, agency: Mansfield and Associates) replied with 18 points and 6 rebounds (made all of his eight free throws) and American forward…
imageCaption: BC Vienna celebrate BSL title (Photo: basketballaustria.at)

title: Basket Swans Gmunden clinch BSL title
description: Kapfenberg - Gmunden 83-90 Gmunden Swans celebrated BSL title. They overcame Kapfenberg Bulls in Game 4 of the championship series to capture the trophy. Kapfenberg Bulls trailed by 20 points after 3 quarters before a 23-10 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 83-90 at the end of the game. Gmunden Swans made 26-of-30 free shots (86.7 percent) during the game. 27 personal fouls committed by Kapfenberg Bulls helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international guard Daniel Friedrich (181-92) who helped to win the game recording 23 points and 7 assists and the former international guard Enis Murati (194-88, agency: Octagon Europe) who added 27 points during the contest.
